satohashDeep.notes: 35/35 pages localized in 7 languages · 18 pages prerendered to static HTML for crawlers · llms.txt live · AI crawlers unblocked in Cloudflare (GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot verified 200 + full content).

sites.name: Satohash

security_headers.plain: Security headers protect visitors. CSP stops injected scripts; HSTS forces secure HTTPS.

robots_txt.plain: robots.txt tells search engines which pages to crawl. Present = good.

sitemap.plain: A sitemap lists every page for search engines — the fastest way to get indexed.

llms_txt.plain: llms.txt is the new standard that AI assistants (ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity) read to learn about a site. Early adopter advantage.

jsonld.plain: Structured data (JSON-LD) helps search engines understand what the site is — and enables rich results in Google.

hreflang.plain: hreflang tags tell Google which language version of a page to show in each country.

prerender.plain: Crawlers see real content (good) vs an empty JavaScript shell (bad — Google and AI bots may not render it).

ai_crawlers.plain: AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) crawl with their own bots. If blocked, they can't learn about the site at all.

sites.plain: Satohash scores 100/100 on SEO-readiness. Strong across the board.

Every site is checked nightly for: HTTP health, security headers, robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt (AI map), structured data, hreflang (languages), static content for crawlers, and AI-crawler reachability. A green check means that signal is live; hover any row for a plain-English explanation.
